products.name: PUDU GT3
products.summary: The GT3 cuts, vacuums, and collects grass clippings, fallen leaves, and light turf debris simultaneously during large-scale rotary mowing. This continuous system leaves behind a spotless field, completely eliminating the need for secondary
products.overview:
The GT3 cuts, vacuums, and collects grass clippings, fallen leaves, and light turf debris simultaneously during large-scale rotary mowing. This continuous system leaves behind a spotless field, completely eliminating the need for secondary cleanups or follow-up crews.

The GT3 handles both mowing and sweeping. Disabling the blades turns the machine into a walkway cleaner, keeping your asset productive all year round.

The GT3 autonomously transits to empty its hopper when full, then returns precisely to the breakpoint to continue its task. This built-in feature ensures seamless performance without requiring operator intervention.

The GT3 instantly recognizes pedestrians, vehicles, and assets like hoses or light poles. Based on risk levels, it automatically slows down, bypasses, or stops to eliminate collision risks on public turf.

products.name: PUDU GT7
products.summary: By merging RTK, LiDAR, and vision systems, the GT7 delivers pinpoint positioning and stable navigation. Its ±2.5 cm RTK accuracy ensures flawless consistency, unlocking fully automated, hands-free operation for every single task.
products.overview:
By merging RTK, LiDAR, and vision systems, the GT7 delivers pinpoint positioning and stable navigation. Its ±2.5 cm RTK accuracy ensures flawless consistency, unlocking fully automated, hands-free operation for every single task.

The GT7 supports advanced configurations for cutting angles, directional rotation, and lane offsets. This enables automated path planning, allowing the GT7 to deliver immaculate, professional-grade turf striping that meets the strict standards of professional athletic fields.

The GT7 moves seamlessly between different pitches or turf zones along pre-mapped internal routes. Eliminating any need for manual relocation, the GT7 automatically transits and resumes mowing upon arrival, letting a single unit cover multiple sports fields effortlessly.

With a wide 62-inch triplex cutting unit, the GT7 perfectly pairs massive cutting efficiency with tight-space agility. The GT7 glides through narrow, twisting paths effortlessly, ensuring seamless coverage across complex sports field layouts.

features.title: Dual-Mode Flexibility
features.text: The GT7 offers dual-mode capability, supporting standard mowing or active grass collection depending on turf conditions. During collection, it features bin-full detection and automatic task resumption to minimize human intervention.
